blocks.text:
## From Mexico's capital to Maya cities and the Yucatán

The final part of the programme takes you to the centre of the Yucatán Peninsula. After Chichen Itza, there is time to swim in a cenote before continuing to Cancun or the Riviera Maya.

Over these 6 days, the architecture and landscapes change several times: the modern metropolis gives way to monumental Teotihuacan, followed by the jungles of Palenque, the fortified walls of Campeche and the Maya cities of the Yucatán. The route continues beyond the archaeological sites to a karst cenote and the Caribbean coast.
